2: To the chief Musician. Upon Shoshannim. Of the sons of Korah. An instruction; — a song of the Beloved. My heart is welling forth [with] a good matter: I say what I have composed touching the king. My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
3: Thou art fairer than the sons of men; grace is poured into thy lips: thereforeGod hath blessed thee for ever.
4: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O mighty one, [in] thy majesty and thy splendour;
5: And [in] thy splendour ride prosperously, because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness: and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
6: Thine arrows are sharp — peoples fall under thee — in the heart of the king's enemies.
7: Thy throne, OGod, is for ever and ever; a sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of thy kingdom:
8: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; thereforeGod, thyGod, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy companions.
9: Myrrh and aloes, cassia, are all thy garments; out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
10: Kings' daughters are among thine honourable women; upon thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
11: Hearken, daughter, and see, and incline thine ear; and forget thine own people and thy father's house:
12: And the king will desire thy beauty; for he is thy Lord, and worship thou him.
13: And the daughter of Tyre with a gift, the rich ones among the people, shall court thy favour.
14: All glorious is the king's daughter within; her clothing is of wrought gold:
15: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of embroidery; the virgins behind her, her companions, shall be brought in unto thee:
16: With joy and gladness shall they be brought; they shall enter into the king's palace.
17: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons; princes shalt thou make them in all the earth.
18: I will make thy name to be remembered throughout all generations; therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.
